versions.content: Bits 3  0 of the NetworkStateCAN shall contain the Tx error counter of the can controller divided by 8 . This is a continuous state that is not related to the source frame that is reported in the same data item, and may also be reported in a data item where the FrameIDAvailable and PayloadAvailable fields are set to 0 .
